name: Banco Mercantil do Brasil S.A.
summary: Banco Mercantil do Brasil S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services to individuals and corporate clients in Brazil. It operates through Financial, Insurance and Business Intermediation, Marketplace, and Other segments. The company offers Current Account, Loans, Cards, Investments, Card receivables, Overdraft, private pension, benefit transfer, special limit, and capital market products. It also provides internet, WhatsApp, Mercantile app, and self-service banking services. In addition, the company engages in real estate, securitization, and technology activities. The company was formerly known as Banco Industrial de Minas Gerais and changed its name to Banco Mercantil…
